data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 180.54m, rising to GBP 250.46m at 31 December 2015. The report does not provide a single explicit GROSS aggregate figure labelled as the 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' in the standard movement note; consequently an authoritative gross prior-year development amount could not be located. The report includes a claims development table and a set of realistic catastrophe stress scenarios (North East/Carolinas windstorm, Gulf of Mexico windstorm, Florida windstorms, California earthquake) which are identified as key catastrophe exposures. No clear, explicit sentence stating the total gross prior year reserve release or strengthening (insurance liabilities column) was found, so the net effect on prior-year reserves is left unquantified here.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2015 was explicitly found (180,539,980). The document does not present a clearly labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' GROSS figure in the standard movement note accessible in the available pages; hence prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null. A claims development triangle exists in the notes (gross amounts) but the scanned images are low resolution for precise extraction of all development-period numbers; consequently a triangle-based PYD calculation was not performed here. Several realistic catastrophe scenario estimates are provided in the risk section (table) and have been captured as named events. Page numbers are approximate based on the scanned sequence. Many reserve movement lines in the P&L (e.g. 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting years') are P&L items (claims incurred) and were intentionally not used per instructions.
